item.title: Inflation Accelerated in October, PCE Index Shows
item.description: The Personal Consumption Expenditures index picked up in September, according to data released a day after the Federal Reserve’s decision to hold interest rates steady.
item.dc:creator: Aruni Soni
item.media:description: A factor pushing prices up this year has been a severe energy crunch created by the war with Iran that sent oil prices soaring.

item.title: U.S. GDP Increased 3.4% in Third Quarter
item.description: The economy grew 3.4 percent in the third quarter, the fastest pace in a year. Strong spending and growth contrast with the poor marks that many voters are giving the economy.
item.dc:creator: Ben Casselman

item.title: Microsoft Up, Google Down. A Tale of Two Hyperscalers.

item.title: Its Investors Say Kalshi Is Worth $40 Billion. Is an I.P.O. Next?

item.title: Volkswagen ‘Must Act Quickly’ After Largest Loss in Over a Decade

item.title: DoorDash to Buy Instacart for $17 Billion, Uniting 2 Delivery Giants

item.title: Christine Lagarde to Step Down as President of European Central Bank

item.media:description: Christine Lagarde’s appointment as the European Central Bank’s first woman president was the latest step in a career of breaking gender barriers, while also contending with economic crises.

item.title: RFK Jr. to Allow Broad Use of Unapproved Peptide Injections

item.dc:creator: Christina Jewett
item.media:description: Peptides are short chains of amino acids that give the body basic instructions. While the F.D.A. has approved some peptide compounds, such as insulin to manage diabetes, many others lack scientific evidence of efficacy or safety.

item.title: What Does the Cheesecake Factory’s Designer Think of Obama and Trump’s Jabs at His Décor?
